descriptions.preferred: This lovely dwarf is the green equivalent of 'Beni hime', being similar in leaf shape and size and growth rate. New foliage is yellow, with bronzed edges and tips, before turning dark green. The yellow-bronze new growth overlying the dark green older foliage continues throughout the growing season. The small five-lobed leaves, 2-2. 5 cm long and 2. 5-3 cm wide, are divided up to two-thirds of the way to the leaf base. Each lobe is broadly ovate, irregular with triangular or bluntly pointed tip, and with toothed margins. As is typical of witches'-brooms, the center lobe is often truncated and occasionally absent. sources.description: 日系品种，意为 " 圆形竖琴 " ，最早于 1977 年日本出版的《盆栽世界》别册中出现记载，属于大红叶矮生品种。 一般为 5 裂叶，叶裂深，每个叶裂都是宽阔的卵形，叶缘较平滑，无明显锯齿，叶小，中央小叶或前 3 小叶会出现缩指的现象，叶柄短，大约 1cm 。 春天初芽时为嫩绿色或黄色并带有红棕色的爪斑，夏季叶色转绿，但是琴丸有非常强的分支能力以及二次稍的生长能力，二次稍为黄色小叶并有红色爪斑，形成二次观赏期，秋天为橙红色或者橙黄色。 生长健壮，枝叶浓密，自然形成一个紧凑密集的球状，成年株可达 1. 5m 左右高度。

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Ideal for container cultivation and small gardens. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一可爱的矮生品种可视为 'Beni hime' 的绿色型，对应于其叶形、叶片大小和生长速度都十分相似。 新叶为黄色，叶缘和叶尖带古铜色，随后转为深绿色。 整个生长季中，黄铜色的新生叶覆盖在深绿色老叶之上，形成持续的色彩层次。 叶片小，5 裂，长 2 至 2. 5 厘米，宽 2. 5 至 3 厘米，分裂深达叶基约三分之二。 每个裂片宽卵形，形状不规则，先端呈三角形或钝尖，叶缘具锯齿。 与典型丛枝变异品种一样，中裂片常为截形，偶尔缺失。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园，乡村/自然式花园，露台/容器植物，花境及花坛
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。
care.cultivation: 宜栽于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，全日照也可耐受。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能引起叶焦。非常适合容器栽培和小型花园。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一种致密、紧凑、极慢生的矮生槭树，最终株高约 1. 5 米。 叶片较小，五裂，春季萌发时为黄色，叶缘和叶尖带铜色，随后转为深绿色；这两种色调在整个生长季都会持续显现，秋季转为黄色和橙色。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Koto maru' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Koto maru’ is a fast growing dwarf Japanese maple. ‘Koto maru’ has very small, rounded leaves that emerge in the spring yellow with a red-oranges border. The coloring of the leaves really puts on a show in the spring. The leaves then fade to a light green throughout the summer. Fall color is then orange to red. ‘Koto maru’ will have long shoots of new growth while it is young, but it will develop into a dense, shrubby tree at maturity. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-5 feet Width: 3-5 feet
